findings: MFA overlapped in all runs; first round9.296s simultaneous MFA. No exact end-to-end speedup percentage inferred.
Round2 Reference results write encountered HTTPError after5.011s, released lease for retry.18.004s from retry acknowledgement to next claim; MFA repeated23.250s.
Round2 learner checkpoint reused on resume without audio read/decode/ASR/MFA.

Normal round3 was slower than round1 with same input; no measured CPU/IO attribution for variance.
After all3runs completed, unrelated blueprint worker Upstash TLS ConnectTimeout caused pnpm dev group exit; not included in measured timings.
recommendations_in_order: P0: retain computed Reference payload and retry the same fenced results write a bounded number of times on transient errors; do not immediately rerun MFA. Stop on lost lease/cancel/delete.
P1: prototype resident isolated MFA aligner per worker, reusing model/lexicon/tokenizer while keeping per-utterance data private; verify same-audio evidence equivalence before rollout.

P2: reduce serial DB calls in registration/upload/status; status currently reads attempt twice plus analysis and reference/source checks. Preserve owner/revocation boundaries, consider single scoped RPC.
P3: wake checkpoint-complete learners on Reference completion instead of fixed15s backoff; use terminal result notification or shorter bounded polling. Not primary cause in runs1/3.
Operational: isolate service supervisors so blueprint network failure cannot terminate acoustic workers; avoid duplicate local worker stacks.
